title: eludite.agents.start, prompt, cancel, configure, switch and new_session output
description: The Agents window's agent and session state: of the session the window shows (brief 0061), the stopped state with no `session` when it shows none.

session.description: The session the window shows (brief 0061): Eludite's own id, its title, when it started and last changed, and whether its agent process runs. Absent when the window shows none.

id.description: Eludite's id for the session (UUID v4), as eludite.agents.sessions lists it.

title.description: The first prompt's first 60 characters on one line; `New session` until a prompt is sent.

state.description: `stopped`: no session; `starting`: spawning, initialize or session/new in flight; `ready`: waiting for a prompt; `needs_login`: the agent reported no login (see `login`); `running`: a turn is in progress; `error`: the agent failed or exited (see `message`).

generation.description: The session generation: it grows on every start or restart. Events of an older generation are dropped.

session_id.description: The ACP session id, once session/new answered.

agent_info.description: The agent's own name and version from ACP initialize (`agentInfo`).

message.description: Why the agent is in `error`, or what it is doing.

login.description: In `needs_login`: the agent's login methods, each with the command to run in a terminal.

command.description: The command line to run in a terminal.

source.description: `native`: the eludite-claude-acp adapter (beside the executable, ELUDITE_CLAUDE_ACP or PATH); `npx`: the Node adapter; `provider`: an OpenAI-compatible server from agents.json's `providers`, run through eludite-openai-acp (brief 0060); `settings`: added by the user in agents.json.

pending_permissions.description: Permission requests waiting for an answer (eludite.agents.permission).

commands.description: The agent's slash commands, from its latest ACP `available_commands_update` (a new list replaces the old one), as the Agents window's slash-command menu offers them. Empty until the agent sends a list, and for an agent that has none. A prompt starting with `/name` runs one; it is text the agent receives.

name.description: The command's name, without the leading `/`.

hint.description: What the command takes after its name (ACP's `input.hint`), when it takes input.

mode.description: The session's mode and the modes the agent offers (ACP `modes`: `session/new`'s `SessionModeState`, then `current_mode_update`), as the Agents window's mode picker shows them. Absent when the agent offers no modes. Every session starts in the agent's own current mode; the shell does not remember a mode.

options.description: The session's config options of the select kind (ACP `configOptions`: `session/new`, then `config_option_update` and the `session/set_config_option` answer), as the Agents window's pickers show them: the model, the effort and any other the agent offers. Options of another kind are not listed. Absent when the agent offers none.

category.description: ACP's category: `mode`, `model`, `model_config`, `thought_level`, or the agent's own.

usage.description: The session's context window and cost as the Agents window's usage strip shows them (brief 0059): the last ACP `usage_update`. Absent before the first one; a restart clears it.

size.description: The context window in tokens; 0 when the agent does not know it.

cost.description: The session's cost so far, the agent's running total.
